unit.why: A single narrative about the Seer of Lublin rescuing R. Hershele of Napatchna, who disobeyed his instruction, from Prussian border guards by a miracle.

stories.start_quote: פ"א בא אל הרבי מלובלין החסיד
stories.end_quote: כי אין זה כלל אותו היין
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin recognizes the wealthy R. Hershele as a relative and orders him to stop in Lublin for permission before each wine-trading trip. When Hershele disobeys, Prussian border guards seize his wine on Saturday night. The Seer, still at the third Sabbath meal, intercedes, and the guards taste the wine, find it is water, laugh and release him. The Seer then assures him that the wine poses no issue of yayin nesekh, because it is not the same wine.
